title: Dynamic Evaluation for Oversensitivity in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's oversensitivity (false refusal rate) by dynamically generating semantically benign prompts containing gender-related trigger words and evaluating whether the model incorrectly rejects them.
